svg.text: Pin assignments taken from main.cpp and platformio.ini · power chain from the project document
INPUT_PULLUP: pin reads LOW when pressed
• All sensors, the TFT and the button/pot ends share the 3V3 and GND solder-bridge rails on the perfboard.
• The analog inputs (GPIO32, 34, 35) are on ADC1, which keeps working while Wi-Fi is active.
• The DC jack and the LiPo are wired in parallel on purpose: the jack is the charge input for the 2S pack
(8.4 V CC/CV adapter, no diode in the path), so it charges with the rocker switch on or off.
• Use only the matching 8.4 V Li-ion adapter on this jack. A plain 12 V adapter would damage the pack.
